title: Detailed red apple
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <!-- shadow/ground glow -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="88" rx="28" ry="6" fill="#2a1040" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- apple body base shape -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="58" rx="30" ry="28" fill="#e8251a"/>

  <!-- lighter red highlight on left side -->
  <ellipse cx="40" cy="54" rx="18" ry="22" fill="#ff4d3a"/>

  <!-- even brighter highlight / sheen -->
  <ellipse cx="36" cy="48" rx="8" ry="12" fill="#ff8877" opacity="0.7"/>

  <!-- small white specular highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="34" cy="44" rx="4" ry="6" fill="#ffd0c8" opacity="0.9"/>
  <ellipse cx="33" cy="42" rx="2" ry="3" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.9"/>

  <!-- right side darker red shading -->
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="60" rx="14" ry="20" fill="#c41a10"/>

  <!-- bottom shading -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="78" rx="20" ry="8" fill="#b5160d" opacity="0.8"/>

  <!-- dimple at top -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="32" rx="10" ry="5" fill="#c41a10"/>

  <!-- stem -->
  <path d="M50 32 Q51 22 55 16" stroke="#6b4226" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M50 32 Q49 24 52 18" stroke="#8b5a30" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- leaf -->
  <path d="M54 22 Q64 14 74 20 Q66 28 54 22 Z" fill="#3aaa35"/>
  <path d="M54 22 Q63 17 72 20" stroke="#5ccf50" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/>
  <path d="M56 22 Q62 20 68 21" stroke="#2a8825" stroke-width="1" fill="none"/>

  <!-- leaf vein highlight -->
  <path d="M56 21.5 Q63 18 70 20" stroke="#7dff70" stroke-width="1" fill="none" opacity="0.7"/>

  <!-- small leaf shadow on apple -->
  <ellipse cx="54" cy="30" rx="6" ry="3" fill="#a01309" opacity="0.5"/>

  <!-- subtle vertical crease/curve on apple -->
  <path d="M50 36 Q46 55 48 78" stroke="#b5160d" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" opacity="0.4"/>
  <path d="M50 36 Q54 55 52 78" stroke="#ff6655" stroke-width="1" fill="none" opacity="0.3"/>
</svg>
